actions.action: Finger-test soil moisture before watering, checking every 2-3 days
If overwatering is suspected, reduce watering frequency and let soil dry more between waterings
Make sure the pot has drainage holes
Water slowly and deeply until water drains from the bottom when soil is dry 2 inches down
Bottom water by setting the pot in a tray of water for 20 minutes
Move plant away from direct sun to an east- or west-facing window
Hang a sheer curtain to filter sunlight if moving is impractical
Watch segments for firming after relocating
Buy and use a digital hygrometer to check humidity
Set up a pebble tray with water under the pot
Refill pebble tray every few days
Run a cool-mist humidifier nearby a few hours a day
Move plant away from vents, drafts, exterior doors and exterior walls
Place an indoor thermometer near the plant to monitor temperature
Tip plant out of pot to inspect root ball
If root-bound, repot into a pot 1-2 inches larger with cactus mix, loosening roots, then water lightly
Fertilize monthly with half-strength balanced liquid fertilizer spring to early fall
Alternatively scratch slow-release granular fertilizer into topsoil every few months

verdict.reason: Underwatering appears only as cause #2 behind overwatering in a generic 12-item list, so diagnosis and the deep-watering fix are buried; overwatering advice is safeguarded by soil checks, so not harmful.
